info.name: Meast — Provider Milestones
info.description:
Provider **milestone packages** — combine multiple services into a single bundle (phases) with auto-calculated timeline and budget.

**Base path:** `{{base_url}}/api/v1`

**Auth:** JWT `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (`auth:api`) + `validate.device`.

**Middleware:** All routes require a complete service-provider profile (`service.profile.provider`). Use `{{provider_token}}`.

**Variables:**
- `milestone_id` — from list/create response
- `milestone_line_id` — from `services[].id` in milestone detail
- `service_category_id` — from `GET /api/v1/service-categories`

**Delivery model values:** `remote`, `on_site`, `hybrid`, `in_person`

**Typical flow:** List categories → Create milestone with `services[]` → Show detail → Toggle activation → Optionally add/update/delete individual service lines.

request.description: Paginated list for **My Milestones** table. Returns `milestones[]` + `meta`.
Detail view with `services` (roadmap phases), `summary` (delivery_model, timeline_days, total_budget).

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Complete E-Commerce Solution",
  "description": "Full-stack package: discovery, design, and development phases delivered as one block.",
  "delivery_model": "hybrid",
  "request_modification_days": 12,
  "activation_status": false,
  "sort_order": 0,
  "services": [
    {
      "service_name": "Discovery & Research",
      "service_category_id": {{service_category_id}},
      "duration_days": 10,
      "budget": 4500,
      "revision_window_days": 12,
      "sort_order": 0
    },
    {
      "service_name": "Landing Page Development",
      "service_category_id": {{service_category_id}},
      "duration_days": 10,
      "budget": 3500,
      "revision_window_days": 5,
      "sort_order": 1
    }
  ]
}

request.description: **Create New Milestone** form. At least one item in `services[]` is required. `duration_days` and `total_budget` on the milestone are calculated from line items.

request.description: Partial update. If `services` is sent, existing lines are **replaced** (full sync).
Deletes milestone and all associated service lines (cascade).
Flips `activation_status`. Requires at least one service line (422 otherwise).

Edit a single roadmap phase. All body fields are optional (`sometimes` validation).
Removes one phase. Milestone totals are recalculated automatically.
